rows.text: "I'm trying to replicate Madam Herta's Curios. Don't ask me who I am. This is just my virtual avatar. I'll offer you something nice... but they're different to how normal Curios work. You have to pay the price first before you get the rewards," it says.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Do you want to take the deal?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
